The meatloaf has a rough, textured surface with visible ground meat, flecks of vegetables (onions/herbs), and a reddish glaze that appears somewhat absorbed rather than glossy. In the background, there are blurred elements including what looks like purple cabbage or lettuce and possibly other food items.

The purple object in the upper right has soft, ill-defined edges and seems to blend slightly into the background, lacking clear structural definition typical of real vegetable leaves.
